description: This file contains utility functions for file path normalization, JSON file reading and writing, and running the Vitest test report generator, including collecting test durations from Vitest JSON report data.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Replaces path separators in the input string with forward slashes for consistency.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a given path to a normalized, repository-relative path, handling absolute and relative paths.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the filesystem.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read a JSON file, returning a fallback value if reading or parsing fails.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes a value as JSON and writes it to the specified file.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Runs the Vitest test runner with JSON reporter, storing output in a file, with optional report path customization.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Collects timing and test count data from a Vitest JSON report, normalizing file paths.
